title: Vaccinium macrocarpon essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Vaccinium macrocarpon essential oil is derived from the American cranberry plant through steam distillation. It contains compounds like phenolic acids and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties. In herbalism, it is used to support urinary tract health and may help with conditions like cystitis. It is also valued for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. This essential oil is often diluted and used in topical applications or as a supportive supplement under professional guidance.
